{{Quote|Welcome to Plazir. Please proceed to your hyperloop pod.|[[Protocol droid]], to [[Din Djarin]] and [[Bo-Katan Kryze]]|<ref name="GunsForHire" />}}
The '''hyperloop pod''' was a form of transport pod moving through a tube at very high speeds. It was used for public ground transportation on the [[planet]] [[Plazir-15]].<ref name="GunsForHire">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 22: Guns for Hire}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The hyperloop pod works similarly to the real-world [[Wikipedia:Hyperloop|hyperloop]], a proposed high-speed ground transportation pod. The hyperloop pods proposed by entrepreneur [[Wikipedia:Elon Musk|Elon Musk]] would travel in a solar-powered tube elevated above ground, and when traveling long distances, would mostly traverse along an existing highway.<ref name="PCMag">{{WebCite|url=https://www.pcmag.com/encyclopedia/term/hyperloop|text=Hyperloop|quote= An ultra-high-speed ground transportation system proposed in 2013 by Elon Musk, cofounder of PayPal, Tesla Motors and founder of space transport company SpaceX. Hyperloop pods ride in a solar-powered, elevated air tube that for long distances would mostly follow an existing highway.|work=''[[Wikipedia:PCMag|PCMag]]''|archivedate=20230406150708}}</ref>
